shelters.name: BARCS - Baltimore Animal Rescue and Care Shelter
shelters.description: Largest animal shelter and pet adoption center in Maryland. Open admission shelter for Baltimore City - no animal or family in need turned away.

shelters.name: Maryland SPCA
shelters.description: Committed to animals since 1869. Over 6,000 spay/neuter surgeries in 2024. Runs The Kibble Connection food pantry. Founding member of BAWA alliance.

shelters.name: Baltimore Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded to protect region's pets and address their suffering. Best Friends Animal Society partner. From the first hello to the last goodbye.

shelters.name: Baltimore County Animal Services
shelters.description: Enforces animal control laws and operates Baltimore County's Animal Shelter. Part of BAWA alliance.

shelters.name: SPCA of Anne Arundel County
shelters.description: Serving Anne Arundel County with animal rescue, adoption, and community events like the Puppy Plunge.

shelters.name: SPCA/Humane Society of Prince George's County
shelters.description: All-volunteer 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Fulfills mission through spay/neuter clinic, cruelty investigations, foster/adoption program, and humane education.

shelters.name: Prince George's County Animal Services
shelters.description: County animal shelter providing animal control and adoption services for Prince George's County.

shelters.name: Montgomery County Humane Society
shelters.description: Pre-eminent animal welfare organization in Montgomery County. Since April 2014, fully independent and 100% privately funded. Private no-kill rescue.

shelters.name: Animal Welfare League of Frederick County
shelters.description: Established 2002 rescuing and finding homes for thousands of animals. Offers official TNR program 'Fixing Frederick's Felines' since 2001.

shelters.name: Calvert Animal Welfare League
shelters.description: No-kill animal welfare organization serving Calvert County with rescue and adoption services.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Dorchester County
shelters.description: Humane society serving Dorchester County on Maryland's Eastern Shore.

shelters.name: HART for Animals
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving Western Maryland with foster-based rescue programs.

shelters.name: PAW - Partnership for Animal Welfare
shelters.description: Foster-based rescue organization serving the greater Washington DC metro area in Maryland.

shelters.name: St. Mary's Animal Welfare League (SMAWL)
shelters.description: Animal welfare organization serving St. Mary's County in Southern Maryland.

shelters.name: Lucky Cat Rescue
shelters.description: Cat rescue organization serving the Baltimore area.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Maryland animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. BARCS is Maryland's largest shelter. Maryland SPCA has served since 1869 and performed 6,000+ surgeries in 2024. Coverage spans Baltimore, Annapolis, Prince George's County, Montgomery County, Frederick County, Calvert County, and Eastern Shore.
